subject.title: feat(clients): adopt model controls, session management, and keyboard history recall on iOS

question: For Apple Review and screenshot fixtures, should iOS preserve the former restricted session UI, or should fixtures implement the full session-mutation and agent-listing contract before these shared controls are exposed?
rationale: The patch currently changes a deliberately constrained fixture experience into unsupported action paths; choosing between capability gating and expanding fixture behavior is a product/test-fixture contract decision.

options.title: Preserve fixture gating
options.body: Disable or hide shared mutation, group, inspector, and advanced-create controls when the active transport lacks their capabilities, matching the prior fixture-safe behavior.

options.title: Implement fixture capabilities
options.body: Add fixture-side session mutations, groups, and agent data so the newly exposed controls are functional during Apple Review and screenshots.

recommendation.title: Preserve fixture gating
recommendation.body: Disable or hide shared mutation, group, inspector, and advanced-create controls when the active transport lacks their capabilities, matching the prior fixture-safe behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the related shared native-chat surfaces and the prior iOS parity wiring that established the fixture-sensitive integration boundary.
